description: This file defines the locale configuration for the Basque language ('eu') for the moment.js date/time library. It specifies months, weekdays, long date formats, calendar formats, relative time expressions, ordinal parsing, and week settings specific to Basque.

methods.name: defineLocale
methods.description: Defines a new locale configuration for moment.js, specifying date and time formats, calendar formats, relative time, and other locale-specific settings.
